name: Kuukou
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional international airport check-in counter: an hours-change notice, a first day working the counter, an airport-usage guide, an online check-in notice, a first-time-user usage guide, a lesson in explaining gate changes kindly, teaching a junior how to handle a lost-baggage report, the airport's history of introducing self-service baggage drop, a lounge-plan guide, a facial-recognition-gate trend column, a hybrid membership-rank system guide, a reflection on balancing efficiency and hospitality, and a one-year report. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
